title: 2.3.5. Virtue Ethics (Character-Based Morality)
content: 👋 እንኳን ወደ Part 4 (የምዕራፍ 2 የመጨረሻ ክፍል) የትምህርት ክላሳችን በሰላም መጡ! በዚህ ክፍል ስለ Virtue Ethics (የስነ-ምግባር በጎነት/መልካም ሰብዕና)፣ የአርስቶትል ትምህርቶች፣ እንዲሁም ስለ Meta-ethics (ሜታ-ኤቲክስ) በጥልቀት እናያለን 👇👇👇。 📌 What is Virtue Ethics? • Virtue Ethics is a normative ethical theory that focuses on moral character and virtues rather than rules or consequences. • It challenges rule-based theories like Deontology and Consequentialism. 👉 ቨርቹ ኤቲክስ (Virtue Ethics) ትኩረቱን በህጎች ወይም በውጤት ላይ ሳይሆን በሰው ልጅ መልካም ሰብዕና፣ ግብረገብነት እና በጎ ልማዶች ላይ የሚያደርግ የስነ-ምግባር ቲዮሪ ነው። --- 🔍 Comparing the 3 Major Ethical Theories (Scenario: Helping Someone in Need): • Deontologist: Acts because of a moral rule or duty (e.g., "Do unto others as you would be done by"). • Consequentialist: Acts because helping will maximize overall well-being/happiness. • Virtue Ethicist: Acts because providing help is charitable and benevolent (charity and benevolence being virtues). 👉 ምሳሌ፦ የተቸገረን ሰው በመረዳት ጊዜ—ዲኦንቶሎጂስት "ግዴታዬ ስለሆነ" ይላል፤ ኮንሲክዌንሻሊስት "ጥሩ ውጤት ስለሚያመጣ" ይላል፤ ቨርቹ ኤቲሲስት ግን "መርዳት የበጎ አድራጎትና የርህራሄ ስብዕና መገለጫ ስለሆነ" ብሎ ይረዳል worldview። 💡 Fun Fact: ቨርቹ ኤቲክስ "ምን ማድረግ አለብኝ?" ከሚለው ይልቅ "ምን ዓይነት ሰው መሆን አለብኝ?" ለሚለው ጥያቄ ቅድሚያ ይሰጣል!

title: 2.3.5.1. Aristotle’s Ethics & Virtue Theory Revival
content: 🏛️ Core Focus: Nicomachean Ethics and the Revival of Virtue • The ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle (384-322 B.C.) first detailed virtue morality in his work Nicomachean Ethics. • He understood 'Virtus' as strength—specific virtues are seen as strengths of moral character. • After Aristotle, virtue theory was overshadowed for centuries by Utilitarianism and Deontology. 👉 አርስቶትል በኒኮማኪያን ኤቲክስ መጽሐፉ ስነ-ምግባርን የበረታ የሞራል ጥንካሬ (Virtus = Strength) እንደሆነ ገልጿል። --- 🔄 The 20th Century Revival (1958 onwards): • Philosophers like Philippa Foot, Alasdair MacIntyre, and Elizabeth Anscombe revived virtue ethics in 1958. • They were disillusioned with rule-calculating theories and argued that living well is better answered by character cultivation. 👉 በ1958 ዓ.ም እነዚህ ፈላስፎች በህግና በስሌት ላይ የተመሰረቱ ቲዮሪዎች በቂ እንዳልሆኑ በመገንዘብ የቨርቹ ኤቲክስን ንድፈ-ሐሳብ እንደገና አንሰራሩት። --- ❓ 4 Key Questions Asked by Virtue Ethical Systems: 1. What sort of person do I want to be? 2. What virtues are characteristic of the person I want to be? 3. What actions will cultivate the virtues I want to possess? 4. What actions will be characteristic of the sort of person I want to be? 👉 የቨርቹ ኤቲክስ 4 ዋና ዋና ጥያቄዎች፡ ምን ዓይነት ሰው መሆን እፈልጋለሁ? ምን ዓይነት መልካም ባህሪያት ሊኖሩኝ ይገባል? ያንን ባህሪ የሚያዳብሩት የትኞቹ ድርጊቶች ናቸው?

title: Aristotle on The Good, Eudaimonia & Happiness
content: 🎯 Core Focus: Teleological Good and Human Flourishing 📌 A. The Concept of "The Good": • The Good is that at which all things aim. Something is "good" if it performs its proper function (Teleological view). • Example: A good coffee cup holds hot liquids well; a good wrench turns bolts effectively. • Eudaimonia: The "highest good" for humans. It is the activity of the soul in accordance with Arete (excellence or virtue). 👉 አንድ ነገር "ጥሩ/መልካም" የሚባለው የተፈጠረበትን ዋና ተግባር (Proper Function) በትክክል ሲወጣ ነው። ለሰው ልጅ ትልቁ በጎ ነገር "Eudaimonia" (ደስታ/እርካታ/ስኬታማ ህይወት) ይባላል። ይሄን ደስታ ደግሞ የምናገኘው የተፈጠርንበትን ትክክለኛ ዓላማ በማሳካት ነው። ሌላ ምሳሌ አንድ መሬት ጥሩ መሬት ነው የምንለው የተዘራውን በአግባቡ ሲያበቅል (Proper function) ነው አይደል? አዎ። Vertue ethics ጥሩ ነው የሚለው መሬቱ የተፈጠረበት ዓላማ ማብቀል ስለሆነ ሳይሆን አብቅሎ ስለተገኘ ነው ማለትም ለተፈጠረበት ዓላማ ተገዢ ስለሆነ ነው። --- 📌 B. Ethics vs. Mathematics: • Moral goodness cannot be answered with mathematical exactitude. • Math starts with general principles to conclusions; Ethics starts with actual moral judgments before formulating principles. 👉 ስነ-ምግባር እንደ ሂሳብ ፍጹም ቀጥተኛ ስሌት የለውም። ከእውነተኛ የህይወት ውሳኔዎች ይጀምራል። --- 📌 C. Happiness vs. Moral Virtue: • Moral virtue alone is not the end of life (because one can be virtuous while inactive, miserable, or suffering). • Happiness (Eudaimonia) requires activity in accordance with reason, involving both moral and intellectual excellence, along with necessary external goods (e.g., health, resources). 👉 መልካም ባህሪ ብቻውን የህይወት መጨረሻ አይደለም፤ ደስታ (Eudaimonia) የሞራልና የእውቀት በጎነቶችን በስራ ላይ ማዋልንና አስፈላጊ ውጫዊ ነገሮችን ይፈልጋል። 📝 Exam Hint: Remember that Eudaimonia is NOT a static state or passive feeling—it is an active process ("Activity of the soul").

title: The Good Character, Habits & Practical Wisdom
content: 🌱 Core Focus: How Virtue is Developed 📌 A. Capacity, Practice, and Habits: • Humans have a natural capacity for good character, but it is developed solely through practice and exercise. • Habits: Structure of habits forms a person's character based on repeated actions. • Arete: A disposition developed out of a capacity through proper exercise. 👉 ሰው በመልካም ባህሪ አይወለድም፤ ነገር ግን የመልካም ባህሪ አቅም አለው። መልካም ባህሪ (Character) የሚገነባው በተደጋጋሚ ልምምድና ልማድ (Habit) ነው። --- 📌 B. Phronesis (Practical Wisdom): • Phronesis is the ability to perceive and choose the right course of action in specific, concrete circumstances. • Aristotle's theory does not imply ethical relativism because objective standards apply according to contextual initial conditions. 👉 Phronesis (ተግባራዊ ጥበብ) ማለት በተለያዩ አጋጣሚዎችና ሁኔታዎች ውስጥ ትክክለኛውን ውሳኔ የመወሰን ችሎታ ነው። 📝 Exam Hint: Acts create dispositions, and once created, good actions flow naturally from those good dispositions!

title: 2.3.5.2. Aristotle’s Doctrine of the Mean (Virtues vs Vices)
content: ⚖️ Core Focus: Virtue as a Mean Between Excess and Deficiency Virtue (Arete) is defined as a mean between two extremes: a vice of excess and a vice of deficiency, as determined by a practically wise person (Phronesis). 📊 Table of Aristotelian Virtues and Vices: • Sphere: Fear - Deficiency: Cowardice (ፍርሃት) - Mean (Virtue): Courage (ጀግንነት) - Excess: Foolhardiness (ሞኝነት/እፅዋት ቢስ ደፋር) • Sphere: Pleasure & Pain - Deficiency: Insensibility (ስሜት አልባነት) - Mean (Virtue): Temperance (ግብረ-ገብነት/መጠነኛነት) - Excess: Self-indulgence (ቅብጥብጥነት/ባለጌነት) • Sphere: Acquisition (Minor) - Deficiency: Tightwad/Stinginess (ስግብግብነት) - Mean (Virtue): Liberality (ልግስና) - Excess: Spendthrift/Prodigality (ብክነት) • Sphere: Anger - Deficiency: Unirascibility (አለመቆጣት/መብትን አለማስከበር) - Mean (Virtue): Patience / Good Temper (ትዕግሥት) - Excess: Hotheadedness (ችኩልነት/ግልፍተኝነት) • Sphere: Social Conduct - Deficiency: Cantankerous (ጭቅጭቅ) - Mean (Virtue): Friendliness (ወዳጅነት) - Excess: Obsequiousness (አላስፈላጊ አሻሻጭነት) 👉 በአርስቶትል አስተምህሮ መካከለኛው መንገድ (The Mean) ሁልጊዜ በጎ ምግባር (Virtue) ሲሆን፣ ማነስ (Deficiency) እና ማብዛት (Excess) ደግሞ ነውረኛነት (Vice) ናቸው። page 64 ያለውን table እዩት እሽ ይጠየቃሉ

title: Dimensions of Virtue, Pleasure, Friendship & Contemplation
content: 🧩 Core Focus: Advanced Aristotelian Concepts 📌 A. Ontological Mean vs. Axiological Extreme: • Ontologically (in nature), virtue is a middle ground. • Axiologically (in value/moral worth), virtue is an extreme of excellence! • Historical Reference: Martin Luther King Jr. quoted in "Letter from Birmingham Jail" that Jesus, Amos, and Paul were "extremists for love and justice." 👉 በተፈጥሮው በጎ ምግባር መካከለኛ ነው፤ በእሴት ደረጃ ግን ፍጹም የሆነ የበላይ የሞራል ደረጃ (Excellence) ነው። --- 📌 B. Aristotle on Pleasure: • Pleasure is a natural accompaniment of unimpeded activity. • Pleasure cannot be directly sought—it is a side-product of activity and perfects the exercise of that activity. 👉 ደስታ በቀጥታ የሚታደስ ሳይሆን በጥሩ ተግባር ምክንያት የሚገኝ ተጨማሪ ውጤት (Side-product) ነው። --- 📌 C. Three Kinds of Friendship: 1. Utility: Based on mutual benefit. 2. Pleasure: Based on enjoyable companionship. 3. The Good (Virtue): Highest form; endures as long as both friends retain good character (a friend is a "second self"). 👉 እውነተኛ ጓደኝነት በበጎ ሰብዕና ላይ የተመሰረተውና ዘላቂው ነው። --- 📌 D. Contemplative Faculty: • The exercise of perfect happiness lies in intellectual/philosophic activity (Reason being the highest human faculty). 👉 ከፍተኛው የደስታ ደረጃ በአእምሯዊና በፍልስፍናዊ አስተንትኖ (Contemplation) የሚገኝ ነው።

title: 2.4. & 2.4.1. Non-Normative Ethics/Meta-Ethics: First-Order vs. Second-Order Questions
content: 🔬 Core Focus: Understanding Non-Normative Ethics 📌 First-Order vs. Second-Order Questions: • Normative Ethics (First-Order): Asks "What ought we to do?" (e.g., "Should I give to famine relief?"). Focuses on moral principles. • Meta-Ethics (Second-Order): Asks "What are we doing when we talk about morality?" (e.g., "What does 'good' or 'right' mean?"). 👉 ኖርማቲቭ ኤቲክስ "ምን ማድረግ አለብን?" ብሎ ሲጠይቅ፣ ሜታ-ኤቲክስ ግን "ጥሩ ወይም ትክክል ማለት ምን ማለት ነው?" ብሎ የስነ-ምግባር ቃላትን ትርጉምና ተፈጥሮ ይመረምራል። --- 🌐 6 Key Domains of Meta-Ethics: 1. Meaning (Semantics): What is the semantic function of moral terms? 2. Metaphysics: Do objective moral facts exist in the universe? 3. Epistemology: How do we acquire moral knowledge? 4. Phenomenology: How are moral qualities experienced by agents? 5. Moral Psychology: What motivates a person to act morally? 6. Objectivity: Can moral statements truly be correct or incorrect? 👉 ሜታ-ኤቲክስ በቋንቋ፣ በዕውቀት፣ በስነ-ልቦና ደረጃ የስነ-ምግባር መሰረቶችን ይመረምራል።

title: 2.4.2. Cognitivism vs. Non-Cognitivism
content: 🧠 Core Focus: Do Moral Statements Express Truth-Apt Beliefs? 📌 1. Cognitivism: • Moral judgments express beliefs. • Beliefs are truth-apt (capable of being evaluated as true or false). • Example: The claim "Murder is wrong" is either true or false based on moral facts. 👉 ኮግኒቲቪዝም፡ የስነ-ምግባር አባባሎች እውነት ወይም ሐሰት ሊባሉ የሚችሉ እምነቶችን (Beliefs) ይገልጻሉ ይለናል። --- 📌 2. Non-Cognitivism: • Moral judgments express non-cognitive states (emotions, feelings, or desires). • Desires and feelings are NOT truth-apt (they cannot be true or false). • Example: Saying "Murder is wrong" is simply expressing personal disgust, not stating a factual truth. 👉 ኖን-ኮግኒቲቪዝም፡ የስነ-ምግባር አባባሎች የስሜትና የምኞት መግለጫዎች እንጂ እውነት ወይም ሐሰት ሊባሉ አይችሉም ይለናል። 📝 Exam Hint: Remember the key phrase: Truth-Apt (እውነት ወይም ሐሰት ለመባል ብቁ የሆነ)!

title: 2.4.2.1. Strong Cognitivism: Naturalism, Non-Naturalism & Error Theory
content: 🏛️ Core Focus: Main Cognitivist Branches 📌 A. Ethical Naturalism: • Moral properties are identical to or reducible to natural properties studied by science or psychology (e.g., maximizing pleasure/human preservation). • Champions: Cornell Realists (Sturgeon, Boyd, Brink). 👉 ናቹራሊዝም፡ የሞራል እውነታዎች ከተፈጥሮአዊ/ሳይንሳዊ እውነታዎች ጋር አንድ ናቸው ይላል። --- 📌 B. Ethical Non-Naturalism: • Moral properties are irreducible, simple, and non-natural (sui generis). • Champions: G.E. Moore (Principia Ethica), John McDowell, David Wiggins. 👉 ነን-ናቹራሊዝም፡ ሞራል በሳይንስ ሊገለጽ የማይችል የተለየ ተፈጥሮ ያለው እውነት ነው ይላል። --- 📌 C. J.L. Mackie’s Error-Theory (Cognitivism without Realism): • Moral judgments are truth-apt, but they are UNIFORMLY FALSE! • Why? Objective moral facts do not exist in the world; such properties would be "metaphysically queer" (utterly strange). 👉 የማኪ ኤረር ቲዮሪ፡ የሞራል አባባሎች እውነት ለመባል ቢሞክሩም፣ በአለም ላይ የሞራል እውነታ ስለሌለ ሁልጊዜ ስህተት (False) ናቸው ይላል። --- 📌 D. Weak Cognitivism (Best Opinion Theories): • Moral judgments are truth-apt, but determined by human best opinion rather than tracking independent facts.

title: 2.4.3. Non-Cognitivism & The Argument from Moral Psychology
content: 🎭 Core Focus: Expressivism and Motivation Debates 📌 3 Major Non-Cognitivist Theories: 1. A.J. Ayer’s Emotivism (1936): Moral judgments express emotions/sentiments of approval or disapproval (The "Boo/Hurrah" theory). 2. Simon Blackburn’s Quasi-Realism (1984): Moral claims express dispositions to form sentiments. 3. Allan Gibbard’s Norm-Expressivism (1990): Moral claims express acceptance of norms. 👉 ኢሞቲቪዝም፡ "ነፍስ መግደል ሀጢያት ነው" ማለት "ኧረ ነፍስ መግደል አይሁንም! (Boo!)" እንደማለት የስሜት መግለጫ ነው ይላል። --- 🚨 The Frege-Geach Problem (Major Challenge to Non-Cognitivism): • Non-cognitivism struggles to explain unexpressed conditional moral logic, such as: "If murder is wrong, then it is wrong to murder your mother-in-law." --- ⚡ Internalism vs. Externalism in Motivation: • Internalism: Internal, necessary connection between moral judgment and motivation. • Externalism: Connection between moral judgment and motivation is external/contingent. • Humean Theory: Motivation requires both Belief + Desire. • Anti-Humean Theory (McDowell): Beliefs alone can be intrinsically motivating!

title: Chapter 2 Final Summary & Course Wrap-Up
content: 🎓 Chapter 2 Summary: Complete Overview • Normative Frameworks Covered: 1. Utilitarianism: Consequentialist; maximizing happiness for the greatest number. 2. Deontology (Kant, Ross, DCT): Duty-based; intentions, commands, and categorical rules. 3. Virtue Ethics (Aristotle): Character-based; habits, Eudaimonia, and the Doctrine of the Mean. • Meta-Ethics Frameworks Covered: 1. Cognitivism vs. Non-Cognitivism: Truth-apt beliefs vs. Emotional expressions. 2. Realism vs. Anti-Realism: Existence of objective moral facts vs. Error Theory/Expressivism. 👉 ምዕራፍ 2 በኖርማቲቭ ኤቲክስ (ውጤት፣ ግዴታ፣ ሰብዕና) እና በሜታ-ኤቲክስ (የስነ-ምግባር ቃላትና እውነታዎች ትርጉም) መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት በሙሉ አጠናቋል። 🎉 እንኳን ደስ አለዎት! የምዕራፍ 2 ትምህርታችንን ሙሉ በሙሉ ተጠናቋል። ለፈተናዎ መልካም ዕድል እንመኛለን! ሰላም ሁኑልን🙋‍♀️!
